_comment: Item profiles for the hand: what a common consumable does on the board. Keyed by the lower-case name of the inventory row. `kind` is heal (on the user or an adjacent ally) or throw (a ranged attack as an improvised weapon, range 20 ft). A row of the sheet may carry its own `profile` of the same shape; it wins over this table. See combat-board.md, section 6.
